title: Qwen Text-to-SQL Lab
description:
A reproducible research repository for adapting Qwen3.5-4B to text-to-SQL with LoRA and QLoRA, and for measuring whether task-specific fine-tuning produces an improvement that survives scrutiny.

The repository is built around one question: how much task-specific data and adapter capacity are required before parameter-efficient fine-tuning produces a measurable improvement over the pretrained or post-trained foundation model?

The primary endpoint is execution accuracy. Generated SQL is executed against the target SQLite database and its result set compared with the result of the verified reference query; textual similarity is retained only as a secondary diagnostic, because two very different queries can be equally correct and two near-identical queries can differ in result.

What the repository provides:

  • schema-grounded data preparation from the BIRD benchmark, with stable example identifiers
  • database-disjoint train/validation splitting, so no schema appears on both sides
  • LoRA and QLoRA adapter training, writing adapter artifacts only
  • a read-only SQLite execution sandbox for scoring generated queries
  • execution metrics with Wilson confidence intervals, and paired bootstrap comparison between models evaluated on identical examples
  • learning-curve and adapter-rank sweeps that hold the remaining training settings fixed
  • a notebook sequence that states, for every result, what it does and does not show

Neither BIRD data nor Qwen model weights are redistributed here; both remain governed by their own licences and terms.
